question: What is the purpose of prototyping in object-oriented system development?

standard_rag.answer: Prototyping is used for specific, experimental purposes to understand the difficulty of implementing system features, allow users to comment on the usability and usefulness of the user interface, assess the fit between software tools, functional specifications, and user needs, and further define use cases to simplify use case modeling. (File: OOAD_CAT_I_StudyMaterial.pdf, Page: 75)
